description: Source code for the InputDevice class in Android, managing input device configuration, state, and interactions within the input system.

classes.name: InputDevice
classes.description: Represents an input device, managing its configuration, state, and interactions within the Android input system.

classes.name: InputDevice::InputDevice
classes.description: Constructor initializing an InputDevice with context, id, generation, and identifier.

classes.name: InputDevice::InputDeviceContext
classes.description: Context class for managing per-device state and operations.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the input device is enabled based on its sub-devices.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the input device and its sub-devices, returning notification arguments.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state and configuration of the device into a string.

methods.name: addEmptyEventHubDevice
methods.description: Adds a new event hub device with the specified ID.

methods.name: addEventHubDevice
methods.description: Adds a new event hub device with configuration, creating mappers accordingly.

methods.name: removeEventHubDevice
methods.description: Removes an event hub device by ID, cleaning up associated controller if needed.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the device with given settings, updating classes, sources, and mappers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all mappers and updates global meta state.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events, dispatching them to mappers and handling overrun conditions.

methods.name: timeoutExpired
methods.description: Handles timeout expiration for input mappers.

methods.name: updateExternalStylusState
methods.description: Updates external stylus state across mappers.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns detailed information about the device.

methods.name: getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific key code.

methods.name: getScanCodeState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific scan code.

methods.name: getSwitchState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific switch.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Generic method to get the state of a key, scan code, or switch.

methods.name: createMappers
methods.description: Creates input mappers based on device classes and configuration.

methods.name: markSupportedKeyCodes
methods.description: Marks supported key codes for the device.

methods.name: getKeyCodeForKeyLocation
methods.description: Gets the key code for a specific key location.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Triggers vibration sequence on the device.

methods.name: cancelVibrate
methods.description: Cancels ongoing vibration.

methods.name: isVibrating
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently vibrating.

methods.name: getVibratorIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of vibrators associated with the device.

methods.name: enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specified sampling and batching parameters.

methods.name: disableSensor
methods.description: Disables a specified sensor.

methods.name: flushSensor
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: cancelTouch
methods.description: Cancels ongoing touch events.

methods.name: setLightColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a device light.

methods.name: setLightPlayerId
methods.description: Sets the player ID for a device light.

methods.name: getLightColor
methods.description: Gets the current color of a device light.

methods.name: getLightPlayerId
methods.description: Gets the player ID of a device light.

methods.name: getMetaState
methods.description: Retrieves the current meta state.

methods.name: updateMetaState
methods.description: Updates meta state based on key code.

methods.name: addKeyRemapping
methods.description: Adds a key remapping rule.

methods.name: bumpGeneration
methods.description: Increments the device's generation counter.

methods.name: notifyReset
methods.description: Creates a reset notification for the device.

methods.name: getAssociatedDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated display, if any.

methods.name: getMapperCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of input mappers.

methods.name: updateLedState
methods.description: Updates the device's LED state.

methods.name: getBatteryEventHubId
methods.description: Returns the event hub ID associated with the device's battery.
